data.name: Shadows Guard
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in a dark action-adventure experience set in Etnik City — a multicultural metropolis full of secrets.

As Luke, a former ONE special operative, you return home after years of exile. But the city you once knew is on the brink of collapse. Gangs rule the streets, corruption has seeped into every layer of society, and beneath it all lies a deeper, more personal darkness.

This third-person, narrative-driven action-adventure blends cinematic storytelling with brutal combat and stealth mechanics. Uncover Luke's past while deciding how to shape his future.

Key Features:

🎮 Dynamic Combat: Utilize a mix of melee and firearms to take on lethal enemies.
🕶️ Stealth Mechanics: Move through shadows, avoid detection, and strike when the time is right — manage your guards carefully.
📖 Branching Story: Your choices will shape Luke’s fate and the city’s future.
🌆 Detailed World: Explore Etnik City — a rich urban environment full of atmosphere and hidden lore.
🎧 Immersive Audio and Original Soundtrack.
